settings.heading: Less, but considered.
settings.text: A simple idea: let the ingredient remain recognisable.

settings.heading: Less intervention. More of the original.
settings.text:
We are drawn to the things that do not need reinventing. Recognisable animal parts, with their own shapes, textures and character.

Our starting point is simple: choose carefully, process only as needed, and be clear about what is inside.

settings.heading: A shorter ingredient list. A clearer connection to the natural world.
settings.text: We believe a good provision begins with something worth keeping, not something that needs disguising.
